english: Let $P$ be a point in the first quadrant on the curve $y=x^{2}$ such that the normal to the curve at $P$ passes through the point $\left(0,\dfrac{9}{2}\right)$. The tangent and the normal to the curve at $P$ meet the $x$-axis at $T$ and $G$, respectively. Then the area of the triangle $PTG$ is ______.
hindi: माना कि वक्र $y=x^{2}$ पर प्रथम चतुर्थांश में $P$ एक ऐसा बिन्दु है कि $P$ पर वक्र का अभिलम्ब बिन्दु $\left(0,\dfrac{9}{2}\right)$ से होकर जाता है। $P$ पर वक्र की स्पर्श रेखा तथा अभिलम्ब $x$-अक्ष को क्रमशः $T$ तथा $G$ पर मिलते हैं। तब त्रिभुज $PTG$ का क्षेत्रफल ______ है।
solution: Subtangent $TM=\dfrac{y}{m}=1$, subnormal $MG=ym=16$ ($M$ the foot of the ordinate), so $TG=17$.
solution_full: For $y=x^{2}$, $y'=2x$. At $P(a,a^{2})$, $a>0$, the slope of the tangent is $2a$ and the normal is $y-a^{2}=-\dfrac{1}{2a}(x-a)$, i.e. $(x-a)+2a(y-a^{2})=0$.

It passes through $\left(0,\frac92\right)$: $-a+2a\left(\frac92-a^{2}\right)=0\Rightarrow a\left(8-2a^{2}\right)=0$. The root $a=0$ is not in the first quadrant, so $a^{2}=4$, $a=2$, $P(2,4)$ and the slope is $m=4$.
Let $M(2,0)$ be the foot of the ordinate of $P$. The subtangent is $TM=\left|\dfrac{y}{m}\right|=\dfrac44=1$, so $T=(1,0)$ (check: tangent $y=4x-4$ meets $y=0$ at $x=1$).
The subnormal is $MG=|y\,m|=4\cdot 4=16$, so $G=(18,0)$ (check: normal $y-4=-\frac14(x-2)$ meets $y=0$ at $x=18$).
$T$ and $G$ lie on opposite sides of $M$, so $TG=TM+MG=17$, and the height of the triangle from $P$ is the ordinate $4$.
originality_note: New: the normal condition through a point on the y-axis fixes P, then the triangle PTG is read off from subtangent plus subnormal (way 5). Closest known: area of the triangle formed by the tangent, normal and x-axis at a given point. Different because: P is not given but defined by a normal passing through (0, 9/2), and the base is subtangent + subnormal.
blueprint_concepts: Equation of a normal to a curve
Length of tangent, subtangent, normal and subnormal

concept_use.Length of tangent, subtangent, normal an: TG = subtangent + subnormal = 1 + 16 gives the base of triangle PTG.

stem_review: Read as a student: every symbol, curve and function introduced with its domain; conditions complete; one reading of each sentence; answer unique and equal to the plan (positive 2-digit integer); Hindi mirrors the English maths. First quadrant excludes the root a = 0. No change.
key_step: Normal through (0,9/2) gives a^2 = 4; base TG = y/m + ym.
justification: Routine two-stage chain (normal condition, then subtangent/subnormal) with no insight; numerical format nudges it but it stays at the level of 2023-P1-Q7 (L2).
